sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 300. Success value 100. 3x magic damage (Time).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Karma.
-Target: all enemies. Applies debuff removal resistance that blocks debuff removal, special debuff removal, or kismet 1 time.
-Target: all enemies. Applies despair for 40 seconds with a success value of 110.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 110. Confuses for 40 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases Unison gauge gains by 2 for 90 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Serenity for 90 seconds (increases max HP, DEF, and MDEF by 100%; nullifies debuffs and Cost reduction. After the effect ends, your character's Unison gauge is filled by 100).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 12000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 12000

[Bewitching Black Dragon] Tio Klarus or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
